page.overview:
Who is Thunder McQueen?

Thunder is a suicidal inmate working as a janitor in Green Dolphin Street Prison. He was given the Stand, Highway to Hell by Whitesnake, which transfers and shares pain. He soon links his death with Ermes Costello's and tries to kill himself repeatedly.

Thunder is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. An "M" shape appears across the right side of his forehead.

He wears fuzzy pants and a short-sleeved shirt with a tag saying "EDWN" on the front of the collar.

McQueen is , suffering from a personality disorder resulting from crippling depression. He mentions that he goes to confession to make himself feel better. He also is quite self-centered, believing himself to be rejected by society.
